cmd_prepare.description: Command executed in the background to prepare the agent.

cmd_terminate.description: Command executed to prepare the agent for termination.

cmd_converge_to.description: Command that prints the ideal number of agents to converge to.

cmd_check_finished.description: Hook to detect if an agent has finished itself.

cmd_try_release.description: Hook to politely ask the agent if it is OK to terminate.

tags.description: List of resalloc tags to use while requesting tickets.

logfile.description: Path to the log file for events.
